name: switchboard
description: Side pane listing your local Claude sessions with their title, status and PR

chime.title: Chime when a session finishes
chime.description: Play a chime when another session goes from busy (yellow) to idle (green).

sound.title: Sound
sound.description: Which sound plays when a session finishes.

showContext.title: Context meter
showContext.description: Show each session's context window meter.

showRepos.title: Repos
showRepos.description: Show the GitHub repos each session touched.

showTickets.title: Tickets
showTickets.description: Show the ticket IDs each session mentioned.

showPr.title: Pull request
showPr.description: Show each session's linked pull request.

workroomNames.title: Name sessions after their workroom
workroomNames.description: Use the workroom folder's name for sessions started inside a workroom-* folder.

ticketUrl.title: Ticket URL prefix
ticketUrl.description: Ticket IDs (like ABC-123) are appended to this to make a link, e.g. https://yourcompany.atlassian.net/browse/. Leave empty to show them without links.

browserHome.title: Browser home page
browserHome.description: The page the New browser button opens.

titleLength.title: Name length
titleLength.description: Session titles longer than this are cut off.

refreshSeconds.title: Refresh every (seconds)
refreshSeconds.description: How often the session list is re-read.
